reasons.message: Model selection ran without separated calibration and test folds.
Candidates were scored on 1 selection fold — too few to rank them, so the strongest baseline (last_value) was published and the candidate scores are evidence, not a ranking.

threshold_artifact.basis: empirical probabilities from backtest residuals scaled to the per-lead-time conformal spread

assumptions: The probability composes conformally scaled per-step marginals under an independence assumption the leads do not satisfy; path-based timing and maximum figures are bootstrap diagnostics.

reasons.message: Only 0 aligned rolling-origin residual paths are available; at least 8 are required for a governed horizon-event probability.
The probability composes published per-step marginals as though forecast leads were independent; the leads are dependent, so this is a best-effort estimate, not a governed joint-event measurement.
The communicated horizon-event probability uses one Jeffreys half-success/half-failure regularisation based on 1 real rolling-origin clusters; the raw independence composition remains a diagnostic.
No untouched test-fold coverage measurement is available; risk is reported but cannot govern an action.
